_comment: Hero ability defs — Q/W/E/R per class. v2 foundation reads Mage (Blaise) only; Knight/Ranger ship in v2.1 per port spec Part 3. Mage values sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 repo: src/modules/village/hero/abilities/mage.ts (MAGE_ABILITIES). Field map: cd -> cooldown, mana -> manaCost, power -> damage, reach -> radius/range (strike/snare = acquire range, aoe/cleave/meteor = blast radius). The 'description' field is a concise 1-line effect blurb for the HUD ability-bar tooltip (WO-36 visual) — NOT canon React data; safe to re-author. Knight + Ranger sets are authored defensible placeholders — NOT yet in the React repo — and must be re-synced when v1 publishes data/abilities.json (port spec Part 8). OPTIONAL 'castAnim' (any ability): names the cast-ANIMATION keyword the ability plays regardless of which Q/W/E/R slot it is equipped in (cast|skill1|skill2|castHeal, or a q/w/e/r slot letter); empty/absent (the default) = derive the cast animation from the effect shape via HeroAbilities.ResolveAnimVariant — fixes a swapped/equipped ability playing the wrong slot's stock cast clip. WO-861 (2026-08-02): the mage + ranger blocks are re-authored to the owner-approved Appendix A1/A2 (Thrain + Sylas); the mage-skills / ranger-skills pools carry the learnable-spell defs their talent trees + the Cathedral of Magic reference. Knight is UNCHANGED.

mage._comment: WO-861 A1 (owner-approved 2026-08-02) — Thrain, the RANGED glass cannon. Q Fireball (free, spammable poke) / W Arcane Shell (NEW 'shield' effect) / E Mend (self-heal) / R Meteor Strike (RETUNED 600 -> 260 per A0). All four carry an 'id' (A4) so hot-swap + the Cathedral unlock path can address them. Mana pool 10, regen 0.9/s — mana IS the survival lifeline; out of mana and engaged = death. 'shield' reads 'damage' as a PERCENT of incoming damage removed and 'seconds' as the duration, exactly the way 'gracebuff' (Warden's Grace) already does — A4 pins it to mirror that mitigation path, NOT a second system. VERIFIED 2026-08-02 against the live code lane: HeroAbilities.ResolveShield reads def.damage as the percent and def.seconds as the window, and HeroHealth.TakeDamage now multiplies by HeroAbilities.DamageTakenMultiplier - the shell is live end to end. WO-1019 PART B (owner rulings 2026-08-10, 'change mend to drain' + 'make meteor strike into poison'): Thrain's fantasy is 'as Mage you try to lure out and kill one at a time', so the bar is now pull -> soften -> finish -> sustain, single-target throughout. E: mage.heal (Mend, flat self-heal) -> mage.drain, effect 'drainshot' (the SAME shipped resolver ranger.healing-shot uses - HeroAbilities.ResolveDrainshot runs the strike then heals the caster by the damage ACTUALLY dealt, so 'steal health' is real today and NO new gameplay code was written for it). R: mage.meteor -> mage.poison, effect 'dot' (HeroAbilities.ResolveDot, the shipped knight.emberbrand-throw shape: an initial hit, then dotDamage per second for dotSeconds) - an ultimate-scale damage-over-time whose damage lives in dotDamage x dotSeconds, NOT in a single 'damage' number. NEITHER DISPLACED SPELL IS DELETED: mage.heal and mage.meteor both MOVED, definition intact, into classes.mage-skills (the learnable pool), so every existing reference to those ids still resolves - notably hero-talents.json mage.t3n1 'Cataclysm Prep' (+60% Meteor radius), which now buffs a POOL spell the player may not have equipped: FLAGGED to the owner, deliberately NOT resolved here. Defaults must be FULL defs (AbilityCatalog.Find reads classes.<class>.abilities[slot] directly, there is no id indirection), so mage.drain / mage.poison are authored HERE and NOT duplicated into the pool - one definition per id. ALL WO-1019 NUMBERS (damage/dotDamage/dotSeconds/cooldown/manaCost/range/castSeconds) AND the three NAMES are <<DRAFT - owner tuning pass>>, pending her sign-off. VFX: only mage.poison has an owner-tagged key - 'Posion_Cast' (her spelling, mapped VERBATIM per the owner-tags-VFX rule; VfxManualPicks.json manual:true -> Spells Pack/.../Nature/Spell_Nature_2_Green Variant.prefab). mage.drain's reversed target->caster beam and mage.thunder HOLD their VFX fields EMPTY pending an owner tag - CLI never creative-picks a key.

q._comment_castSeconds: WO-1105 R3 (owner ruling 2026-08-16) - THE SHOT ROOTS THE SHOOTER. This is the PLANTED-SHOT window: HeroAbilities.CastRoutine holds the wind-up for castSeconds and HeroLocomotion.WantsToMove CANCELS the shot outright (mana+cooldown refunded, and the player is TOLD via a toast - no silent refusal). Owner rationale, recorded here so nobody 'fixes' it back to instant: free move-and-shoot trivialises melee threat entirely. This pairs with the standing decision that the DAGGER is the primary attack and the BOW is an action-bar ability - bow = committed and dangerous, dagger = mobile and safe. That is the loop. 0.45s is a SEEDED STARTING VALUE for the owner to tune (it matches this ability's own cooldown, and sits between the 0.35s utility casts and the 0.5s ultimates); it is DATA precisely so tuning it never needs a code change. Setting it to 0 restores instant fire with no root.

mage-skills._comment: WO-861 A1/A3/A4 — FLAT pool of LEARNABLE mage spells (the 'mage.*' ids that trees.mage nodes and the Cathedral of Magic tier unlocks reference by abilityId / unlockSpell). Same contract as knight-skills: a unique 'id' resolved by AbilityCatalog.FindById; 'slot' is only the chooser's SUGGESTED slot. mage.frost-nova and mage.arcane-bolt are PORTED VERBATIM from the mage Q/W that A1 retired (same tuning + same VFX keys) so no shipped balance is silently lost. mage.manaweave uses the NEW 'manaweave' effect (A4: restore ~5 mana over 3s through the existing _manaOverTimeRate/Until drip) — 'damage' carries the MANA amount and 'seconds' the drip window; it costs no mana by design (it is the mana-recovery button). VFX: only the four owner-tagged hooks (FireImpact_Impact / Fire_Cast / FireballTower_Projectile / NoneMageHealingCast_Cast) plus keys carried over from a ported def are wired here; every other new spell deliberately HOLDS its VFX fields empty pending an owner tag (VFX-tagging workflow: CLI never creative-picks a key). WO-1019 Part B adds THREE rows here: mage.thunder is the NEW learnable single-target burst finisher (effect 'strike', the plain shipped Strike branch - shape copied from knight.thunderbolt, 30 dmg / 3s cd / 16m, retuned up to a heavier finisher on a longer cooldown); mage.heal (Mend) and mage.meteor (Meteor Strike) are the two DEFAULTS the owner's E/R ruling displaced, MOVED here verbatim rather than deleted so hero-talents.json mage.t3n1 ('Cataclysm Prep' -> mage.meteor) and any unlock reference keep resolving. mage.thunder's VFX fields are HELD EMPTY pending an owner tag (knight.thunderbolt's Thunderbolt_Cast/_Projectile/_Impact keys are NOT reused - reusing a look-alike is exactly the creative pick the rule forbids). Thunder's numbers and name are <<DRAFT - owner tuning pass>>.
